notes.title: Changelog for Monsters Domain Prologue
notes.content:
🌟 Improved Translations: No language barriers - now everyone will understand what's going on!
🎮 Controller Support: Feel like a true hero playing with your favorite controller!
⚔️ New Armor and Weapons: The right gear is key to defeating evil!
👊 Revamped Combat Mechanics: Engaging and thrilling gameplay like never before!
🌲 New Skill Tree: Develop your character according to your own preferences!
🎨 Upgraded Graphics: Get ready for a visual feast!
🤖 Enhanced AI: Enemies will show no mercy!
🏟️ Arena System: Defend your Domain against hordes of enemies!
📛 Minion Renaming Feature: Your loyal companions deserve names!
⚖️ Balanced Gameplay: Fairness for all!
🌟 Three Difficulty Levels: From novice to master - everyone will find something for themselves!
💾 Updated Save System: No worries about losing progress!
🐞 Bug Fixes and Optimizations: Smaller bugs, greater stability!

notes.title: Update and preparation for the full version
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38924877/b379ae5120537a4cdc300ac6c99fa5471aef2425.png[/img]

Hello, players of the "[b]Monsters Domain[/b]" community!

We wanted to let you all know that we are currently working on polishing the full version of the game to provide you with an incredible and unforgettable experience . As a result, our focus is currently on perfecting the full version, so we have not been updating the prologue version, but don't worry - we'll be updating the prologue soon too!!! However, we have many exciting new features coming your way soon!

[b]What has changed:[/b]

[list]
[*] Full controller support: We're making it easier for you to interact with the game by enabling support for various types of controllers. Now you can enjoy smooth and comfortable controls that will fully immerse you in the world of "Monsters Domain."
[*] Improved combat system: We've reworked and enhanced the combat system to allow for even more dynamic and satisfying battles with enemies. Get ready for exciting encounters and new tactical opportunities!
[*] Raids on our city: Exciting new challenges await you in the form of thrilling raids on our city! Prepare your team, earn rewards, and defend our shared home from attackers.
[*] Enhanced tutorial: We want you to feel more confident in the world of "Monsters Domain" right from the start. That's why we've redesigned and improved the tutorial to help you better understand the game mechanics and begin your adventure without any obstacles.
[*] Bug fixes: Thank you for reporting all the bugs and issues. Thanks to your feedback, we're continuously working on improving the game's quality and eliminating any imperfections.
[*] Localization: We're striving to tailor the game to your needs by providing better localization. Soon, you'll be able to enjoy an even more immersive experience with available language versions.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38924877/33e2abbe28a3bdb8c5f97d3d0203e3854b6d34ae.png[/img]

[b]What's to come:[/b]

But that's not the end of our plans! We're still working on many aspects of the game, including better translations and gameplay balance. We'd also love to hear from you! What enhancements and novelties are you most interested in? Let us know what you're looking forward to the most!

[b]Full version release date:[/b]

And finally, you're probably eager to know when you'll be able to experience the full version of "Monsters Domain." We have good news for you – the release date is approaching rapidly! Stay tuned, as we'll soon announce the exact premiere date.

[b]Final round of playtesting:[/b]

Before the official game release, we plan to conduct a final round of playtesting on our main application. This is a great opportunity for you to provide us with valuable feedback and help us fine-tune the last details before the full release. Be ready to participate in this stage and follow our social channels for more information!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38924877/9ee4cde77ff8567e25b51718f3bfdb708e095688.png[/img]

Thank you for your support, patience, and engagement. Without your passion and attention, "Monsters Domain" wouldn't be what it is today. Together, we're creating an unforgettable adventure that will soon become even more exciting. See you in the realm of monsters!

Do you want to help in game development? [b]Join our Discord[/b]! https://discord.gg/bdswRgkXZe


Warm regards,
The "Monsters Domain" Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38924877/1e95ee6c7575ac16d40428758655fbf2a8108875.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
Dear players,

We are excited to inform you that we have released a game patch addressing several issues. The following bugs have been fixed:

[list]
[*] Fixed inventory disappearance after possess bug.
[*] Fixed item weight issue.
[*] Fixed swap menu lock when teleporting from a staff.
[*] Fixed charged staff attack loop bug.
[*] Fixed bug with holy mist, which allowed you to pass through without being in spirit mode.
[*] Audio save has been fixed.
[*] Key binding issue has been resolved.
[*] Many reported minor bugs.
[/list]

We would like to let you know that we are also working on enhancing the combat experience, preparing full controller support, and implementing many other improvements. All these options will be available in the full version of the game. We want to express our gratitude to everyone who has been reporting bugs and helping us in the development of the game.

We kindly request all players to leave their feedback, suggestions, and any other comments here (in comments or on our discord). Your input will be valuable in shaping the full version of the game.

Thank you for your support!
G-DEVS.com

notes.title: Patch 1.0
notes.content:
Dear Monsters Domain Players,

We would like to express our heartfelt gratitude for your interest in our game. Thank you for taking the time to provide us with valuable reviews, both positive and negative. Your feedback has been instrumental in shaping the game and making it better.

We are continuously working on improving Monsters Domain to deliver the best gaming experience possible. We are excited to announce the release of Patch 1.0, which includes the following updates:

[h2][b]We changed [u]LEFT SHIFT[/u] key to [u]F[/u] key[/b][/h2]

Improvements:

[list]
[*] Faster heavy attacks.
[*] Heavy attacks now have the ability to knock down enemies and deal increased damage.
[*] New loot and enemies have been added to encourage exploration.
[*] Crystals can now be destroyed with just two hits.
[*] Additional combat voices have been added for enemies.
[*] Improved parry stun mechanics.
[*] Enhanced visibility for loot bags.
[*] Various general improvements in nav mesh and levels.
[/list]

Bug Fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed the issue causing the dungeon to appear completely black.
[*] Resolved the problem with automatic cutscene skipping.
[*] Addressed the salvage yard upgrade issue prior to the tomb.
[*] Fixed the bug causing duplicated items in exchanges.
[*] Corrected the negative stat value bug.
[*] Fixed the issue with equipment updates in minion previews (exchange window).
[*] Resolved the skill block problem.
[*] Fixed the level 3 tomb upgrade minion reward.
[*] Addressed the issue of consuming excess building resources for level 1 buildings.
[*] Fixed the rank update bug for players when traveling to a new map.
[*] Resolved the bug related to summoned wolves.
[*] General and minor bug fixes.
[/list]

We are committed to providing you with the best possible gaming experience, and we appreciate your continued support. Please keep the feedback coming, as it helps us make Monsters Domain even better.

Thank you once again for choosing to embark on this adventure with us!

We would like to extend an invitation to all those who are interested in contributing to the development of Monsters Domain to join our [url=https://discord.gg/rHRxnr3xpR]Discord [/url]community.

Best regards,
G-DEVS.com
